desks.headline: Amit cashes in on 2 differential returns
desks.text: Amit is the day's standout: **Dewsbury-Hall scored and Gibbs-White set one up**, and nobody else owns either. Amit sits **8 behind Sunny** in 10th, and Chandru's Isak captaincy is still to come against Matt's **3-point lead** for the last Gold spot.

desks.headline: Haaland blanks and 15 armbands go to waste
desks.text: Haaland blanked, and the **15 armbands** wasted on him have left Deepak **17 behind** Nikhil at the top. Nikhil's Calafiori has already hauled 12 for the leader, and the title race could tighten if Groß or Silva deliver as kick-off approaches.

desks.headline: Haaland's blank wastes 15 armbands at the top
desks.text: Haaland blanked and **15 armbands** went to waste, yet Deepak still sits **17 behind** Nikhil at the top. Groß is the one player Deepak still has to play, while **Silva and Barcola** are the only ones left for Nikhil to protect the lead.

desks.headline: Nikhil's 17-point cushion faces Deepak's late Groß hopes
desks.text: With kick-off about 2 hours away, **Nikhil leads on 694** and **Deepak sits 17 behind**. Nikhil's Calafiori has already hauled 12, and only Silva and Barcola remain for him to protect the lead. Deepak's hopes rest on Groß, the only player he has left to play.

desks.headline: Nikhil's 17-point lead rests on Silva and Barcola
desks.text: Nikhil holds the top spot with a **17-point cushion** over Deepak, and his captain Calafiori has already played. Deepak's comeback hangs on **Groß**, the only player he still has to see, while **Silva and Barcola** are all that's left for Nikhil to protect the lead.

desks.headline: Nikhil's 17-point cushion faces Deepak's Groß test
desks.text: Nikhil holds the top spot with a **17-point cushion** over Deepak, and Calafiori has delivered 12 for him. Deepak's comeback hangs on **Groß**, the only player he still has to see, while Nikhil needs Silva and Barcola to hold firm when BHA v BRE kicks off in an hour.

desks.headline: Nikhil's benched Groß could test the top spot
desks.text: Nikhil holds the top spot on **699**, **18 clear of Deepak**, yet **Groß is on the pitch** at BHA v BRE and Nikhil is one of the 2 managers who benched him. Deepak and Ravin share second on 681, and if Groß scores, Nikhil's cushion could be tested.

desks.headline: Evanilson scores, lifting captains Sunil and Poonam
desks.text: Evanilson has scored for IPS v BOU, and he is worth **5** to the 8 managers who started him. His **10** captain haul has lifted Sunil and Poonam, with Sunil up from 12th to 10th and Poonam from 18th to 16th. Gomez also scored, but Chandru benched him, so that one stings.

desks.headline: Brobbey assists after Rajiv's sale, and the top spot wobbles
desks.text: Rajiv sold Brobbey this week, and now Brobbey has **assisted** and is on **4** points, a timing lesson nobody wanted. Rajiv sits **20th** and it stings. The real drama is top spot, where Nikhil's **18-point** lead over Deepak could wobble if Groß gets going at BHA v BRE.

desks.headline: Groß scores after Nikhil benched him, top spot wobbles
desks.text: **Groß** has scored for BHA v BRE, and Nikhil and Rajiv, who benched him, are feeling it. Nikhil leads on 701, yet **Deepak** is just **12** back. 17 managers started him, so the top spot could tighten if he keeps going.

desks.headline: Wirtz's 7-point goal is Matt and Bella's private joy
desks.text: **Wirtz** has scored for CRY v LIV, and his **7** points belong only to Matt and Bella. That differential return helps Matt, who sits **18** ahead of Chandru in the last Gold spot fight. Matt's own Manzambi is still to play when MUN v AVL kicks off, and he could add to that cushion.

desks.headline: Barcola assists for Nikhil and Ravi Mahtani alone
desks.text: **Barcola** has assisted at CRY v LIV, and his **5** points belong only to Nikhil and Ravi Mahtani. That is a big boost for Nikhil, who leads Ravin by **12** at the top. Ravin's Rogers is still playing, so the top spot could tighten.

desks.headline: Wirtz's 13-point haul is Matt and Bella's private joy
desks.text: **Wirtz** has set up a goal and scored in CRY v LIV, and his **13** points belong only to Matt and Bella. That differential haul keeps Matt in the top-spot fight, **3** behind Nikhil, with Manzambi still to play when MUN v AVL kicks off. Nikhil's Calafiori has already played.

desks.headline: Matt's Bench Boost chases Nikhil for the top spot
desks.text: **Matt** trails Nikhil by **3** at the top, with his Bench Boost keeping every bench option in play. **Manzambi** is the only player Matt still has to come when MUN v AVL kicks off, and if he hauls, Matt could close the gap. Nikhil still has one player to come.

desks.headline: N.Jackson's goal puts Pishu's armband in the Tin Pot fight
desks.text: **N.Jackson** has scored in MUN v AVL, and his **5** points belong to 15 managers, with Pishu's armband paying 10 as his only captain. That lifts Pishu **2** ahead of Rajiv in the fight to escape the Tin Pot. The Tin Pot picture could shift as MUN v AVL plays on.

desks.headline: B.Fernandes scores and only Vanessa owns the points
desks.text: **B.Fernandes** has scored in MUN v AVL, and his **6** points belong to Vanessa alone, a differential return that has lifted her level with Hishaan in 15th. At the top, Matt sits **2** behind Nikhil, so the title race is still wide open and one more goal could change it.

desks.headline: Nikhil holds the top by 2 as Matt's Bench Boost chases
desks.text: **Nikhil** holds top spot on **718**, with Matt **2** behind after Wirtz's assist, which only Matt and Bella own. MUN v AVL is still 2-2, and B.Fernandes's goal is worth **6** to Vanessa alone. If Matt's Bench Boost lifts him past Nikhil, the title race could tighten.

desks.headline: Haaland's 4 on 15 armbands leaves Nikhil clinging to top
desks.text: **Haaland** returned just **4** for the 15 managers who captained him, which cost Matt and Deepak dearly while **Nikhil** keeps top spot on **717**. Matt sits **2** behind on 715 with his Bench Boost live, and MUN v AVL, 2-3 at 52 minutes, could still shuffle the top 2.

desks.headline: N.Jackson's goal and assist lift Pishu out of Tin Pot
desks.text: N.Jackson's assist, plus the goal, has him on **11** points, and Pishu's armband returns **22** from him alone. That puts Pishu level with Lakshay on **618**, **9** clear of Rajiv in the Tin Pot. MUN v AVL is 2-4 at 65 minutes, so more could still come.

desks.headline: Vanessa's solo Fernandes assist keeps her level with Hishaan
desks.text: **B.Fernandes** has set up a goal in MUN v AVL, which is level at 4-4, and it is worth **10** points to Vanessa alone. That takes her gameweek to **59** and keeps her level on **634** with Hishaan, the pair locked in a close battle.

desks.headline: Haaland's blank for 15 armbands costs Matt top spot by one
desks.text: Nikhil holds top on **723**, one ahead of Matt, after Haaland's **4** for 15 armbands cost Matt dearly. Pishu's N.Jackson armband paid **22**, lifting him out of the Tin Pot. Before kick-off we said Palmer's blank could flip the Tin Pot, and he managed just 2.

desks.headline: Matt's 96 Bench Boost wins the week, Nikhil holds top
desks.text: Matt's Bench Boost hauled **96**, the week's best score, and he's **1** behind Nikhil at the top. Ravi Mahtani had the grimmest week, slumping to 17th. Before kick-off we said Palmer's blank could flip the Tin Pot, and he managed just 2.

desks.headline: Matt's Bench Boost hauls 96, Nikhil clings to top
desks.text: Matt's **96-point Bench Boost** was the week's best score, lifting him from 5th to 2nd, just **1** behind Nikhil at the top. Ravin's slide from 1st to 4th shows how quickly the table can change. Before kick-off we said Palmer's blank could flip the Tin Pot, and he managed just 2.

desks.headline: Matt's Bench Boost hauls 96 and nearly topples Nikhil
desks.text: Matt's **96-point Bench Boost** was the week's best score, hauling him from 5th to 2nd and **1** behind Nikhil at the top. Ravin's slide from 1st to 4th shows how fast the table turns. Before kick-off we said Palmer's blank could flip the Tin Pot, and he managed just 2.

lines.text: If Evanilson hauls, Lakshay could pass Ravi Mahtani.
